implemented_coverage.notes: Recognized directly by model profile and causal loader helpers, but not listed as a public support lane.
Generic Llama-family profile handling is first-class. OpenLLaMA and TinyLlama now provide ungated declared support lanes, while access-gated vendor checkpoints remain omitted.
Shared qwen-family heuristics still cover aliases beyond the declared Qwen2, Qwen2.5 14B, Qwen3, and Qwen3.5 public lanes, including usage-only Qwen2.5 checkpoints.
Yi is treated as a RoPE decoder family in profile and adapter-auto logic.
Phi-family selectors are first-class. Phi-4 now has a declared text-only lane via the reasoning-plus pilot, while multimodal Phi-4 remains backlog-only.
Gemma 3/4 selectors and loaders are first-class. Gemma 4 E2B now has a declared text-only lane, image-text evaluation is shipped through hf_multimodal + vision_text, and audio remains deferred.
These families are available through shared GPT-style loader and profile paths rather than dedicated public support lanes.
GPT-OSS rides the shared GPT-style profile path, with an explicit HF causal loader hint for the published open-weight checkpoint.
Falcon 7B now has a declared support lane; remaining Falcon-family coverage is available through adapter-auto heuristics and variant-path tests.
Family visibility currently comes from adapter-auto heuristics only.

DeepSeek distill checkpoints continue to share the qwen-family route. Oversized FP8 checkpoint-specific repo hooks and shipped configs were removed after bring-up showed that they do not fit the supported hardware/runtime path.
Loader and adapter-auto support exceeds the public BERT / RoBERTa support lane.
Concrete loader families exist even though the public support matrix keeps seq2seq at a generic local-pairs lane.

repo_gaps: No processor-aware audio dataset provider or audio report surface exists today
